dict.nffgirls.name: Mob Dictionary - By NFF: Girls
dict.nffgirls.landing_text: This guidebook introduces mobs involved in NFF: Girls, and how to interact with them.
dict.nffgirls.title_mobs.desc: Information about mobs in NFF: Girls.
dict.nffgirls.title_friending.desc: Methods to get friendly with mobs.$(br2)Browse JEI tab to find item lists for friending. Open JEI GUI -> press the top bar to show all tabs -> find "NFF: Girls - Items for Friending" tab -> find target mob.
dict.nffgirls.title_interaction.desc: Interaction mechanics for tamed mobs.$(br2)Browse JEI tab to find item lists for healing. Open JEI GUI -> press the top bar to show all tabs -> find "NFF: Girls - Items for Healing" tab -> find target mob.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.alraune: The Alraune is a spirit of nature and plants, found in the Jungle biomes above Y=64.$(br2)They can perform 2 types of attack depending on the distance to their enemies. When the enemy is close, they perform melee attack, giving Poison II, Weakness III and Slowness III. If the enemy is far away, they can shoot poisonous seeds and give Poison I, Weakness I and Slowness I. They are immune to Poison and Nausea effects.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.alraune_1: They love moisture. When they are in water or rain, they will gain Regeneration III. Oppositely, they are weak to fire damage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.banshee: The Banshee is a peculiar spirit which keeps a pose of buried face, found in the Taiga and Mountain biomes above Y=64.$(br2)They float in the air and attack by rushing to their prey. The attack gives Weakness and Hunger I.$(br2)They are an undead mob, and burn under the sun. They have 2 different textures.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.catoblepas: The Catoblepas is a bull-like monster found in the Plain and Savanna biomes above Y=64.$(br2)Their attack has a strong knockback, and gives Blindness and Slowness II. They are immune to Blindness effect.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.creeper_girl: The Creeper Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of the Creeper in the Overworld. Their behaviors are similar to the Vanilla Creeper while the attributes are a bit higher. In addition, they have the sound of footsteps, allowing you to hear their approach.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.crimson_slaughter: The Crimson Slaughterer is a dangerous creature found rarely in the Crimson Forest.$(br2)They have higher attributes than most other mobs in this mod, and can step onto 3 blocks above, making it dangerous to fight closely against them. Their attack can cause Hunger II, Slowness I and Mining Fatigue I. They are an arthropod, and weapons with Bane of Arthropod enchantment can deal them more damage.

The Crimson Slaughterer is highly adaptive for extreme conditions. They are immune to fire and falling damage, and Poison and Hunger effects. Also, they are resistant to projectiles, suffocation and Cactus.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.cursed_doll: The Cursed Doll is a magical creature found in the Forest biomes above Y=64.$(br2)They hold a Wooden or Stone Axe as weapon. The attack has a strong knockback, can disable the shield, and deals Slowness I.$(br2)They burn under the sun, and are weak to fire damage. They fall slowly like the Chicken, and don't take falling damage. They can step onto 1.5 blocks above.$(br2)The Cursed Doll doesn't have the sound of footsteps. Be aware of their “surprise”.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dodomeki: The Dodomeki is a monster from the legends of the eastern islands, found in the Taiga biomes above Y=64. Their melee attack gives Slowness I. They burn under the sun, although they are not undead.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dogu: The Dogu is an ancient automated golem warrior, found underground in the Jungle and Badland biomes.$(br2)They spawn with a Stone or Iron Sword, and don't have the sound of footsteps. Their attack has a strong knockback, and gives Slowness II and Mining Fatigue II.$(br2)The Dogu can breathe underwater, and is immune to falling and Cactus damage. They are resistant to projectiles, explosions, Powder Snow and falling blocks like the Anvil, but weak to the Pickaxe.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.drowned_girl: The Drowned Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of the Drowned in the Overworld. Their behaviors are similar to the Vanilla Drowned while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dullahan: The Dullahan is a scary creature with a headless appearance, found in the Dark Forest and Mountain biomes above Y=64. They hold a Stone Sword as weapon, and the attack can give Weakness I.$(br2)As a powerful fighter, they are resistant to magic. They burn under the sun, although not undead.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dyssomnia: The Dyssomnia is the leader of Phantoms. They are stronger than the Phantom, larger and more dangerous. They can be found in open biomes like the Plain, and the spawn chance depends on the phase of the moon. They are most likely to spawn under the full moon, and don't spawn at all under the new moon.$(br2)The Dyssomnia attacks by shooting magical bullets and gives Blindness. Also, they can summon Phantoms during the combat.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.dyssomnia_1: The Dyssomnia is immune to Blindness. Although undead, they don't burn under the sun, but fly right upward and disappear.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ender_executor: The Ender Executor spawns occasionally in place of the Ender Man in the End. They are rare in the Overworld and the Nether, but common in the End.$(br2)Their health and attack attributes are much higher than the Ender Man. They spawn with a Stone Sword, and their other features are similar to the Ender Man.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ender_executor_1: Besides melee attack, the Ender Executor can also perform beam attack like the Guardian. The beam has very long tracking distance, but can be stopped by solid blocks.$(br2)Therefore, it is inadvisable to rashly provoke an Ender Executor.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.fortress_keeper: The Fortress Keeper is a powerful golem made of Nether Bricks, and spawns in the Nether Fortress.$(br2)They can perform both close and distant attack. When their enemy is close, they will perform melee attack, making a strong knockback and giving Slowness I. When the enemy is far away, they can shoot projectiles causing fire and small explosions.$(br2)The Fortress Keeper is immune to fire, and resistant to projectiles, magic and Cactus.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ghastly_seeker: The Ghastly Seeker is a rare mob which only spawns in place of the Ghast in a small chance.$(br2)The features of the Ghastly Seeker are similar to vanilla Ghasts, but they have much higher attributes. Besides, the damage from their own fireball cannot immediately kill them but only deals twice the damage.$(br2)As a Nether mob, they are immune to fire damage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ghost: The Ghost is a hostile spirit in the darkness, found everywhere in the Overworld. They float in the air, approach the player slowly, and rush to the player to perform melee attack.$(br2)Sometimes, the Ghost can spawn with a golden tool or weapon. They are undead and burn under the sun.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.giant_mummy: The Giant Mummy is an ancient undead monster, found in the Desert biomes and the Desert Pyramids.$(br2)When attacking, the Giant Mummy can break some blocks nearby, and give Slowness I and Hunger. They are resistant to projectiles.$(br2)As an undead mob, the Giant Mummy burns under the sun.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.glaryad: The Glaryad is a neutral mob found in the Lush Cave biomes. When attacked, they will alert other Glaryads nearby like the Zombified Piglin. Their melee attack gives Slowness I.$(br2)They love moisture as a plant monster. When in water or rain, they will get Regeneration III effect. Oppositely, they are weak to fire damage.$(br2)You can hold a Mysterious Petal on your hand to attract the Glaryad. They will follow you if so, but can still be provoked if attacked.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.harpy: The Harpy is a common creature found in the Plain, Savanna and Desert biomes above Y=64. Their attack has a strong knockback. They fall slowly like the Chicken and are immune to falling damage. They can step onto 1.5 blocks above.$(br2)The Harpy has 6 different common colors depending on the biomes. Besides, there's another hidden color that can be found anywhere but incredibly rarely.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.hornet: The Hornet is a flying insect creature found in the Forest biomes above Y=64. They spawn with an Iron Spear and rush to their prey to perform melee attack. Their attack gives Poison II when the difficulty is normal or above.$(br2)The Hornet is an arthropod and is weak to Bane of Arthropod enchantment. They are also weak to fire.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.husk_girl: The Husk Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of Zombies in the Desert biomes. Their behaviors are similar to Vanilla Husks while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.imp: The Imp is a resident of the Nether, found in the Nether Wastes, the Crimson Forest and the Basalt Delta biomes.$(br2)They spawn with a Golden Fork. Their melee attack gives Weakness I and Mining Fatigue I when the difficulty is normal or above.$(br2)As a Nether mob, the Imp is immune to fire damage, and is resistant to falling and magical damages.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.jack_frost: The Jack o' Frost is a spirit of the ice element, found in snowy biomes above Y=64. They attack by shooting snowballs. When they step onto the water, they can freeze the water like the Frost Walker enchantment.$(br2)The Jack o' Frost is weak to the heat and fire damage. They will take damage in hot biomes like the Desert. They can get Regeneration I when in Powder Snow.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.jiangshi: The Jiangshi is an undead creature from the eastern continent, found in the Bamboo Jungle biome above Y=64. They hop toward the enemies and perform melee attack. Their attack has a strong knockback and gives Poison I.$(br2)When a Jiangshi is damaged, their movement speed will be boosted, and return to normal gradually. If on fire or hit by the thunder, the speed will immediately return to normal.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.jiangshi_1: They are resistant to projectiles. As an undead mob, they burn under the sun.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.kasha: The Kasha is a cat-like monster found in the Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley and Basalt Delta biomes. They stalk to their prey silently and rush suddenly to attack. Their attack has a strong knockback and ignites the enemy.$(br2)When spawned on Soul Sand or Soul Soil, they will become a variation of soul fire, and be slightly stronger than normal ones.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.kasha_1: The Kasha is immune to fire, but takes damage in water or rain. They are also immune to falling damage and can jump onto 2 blocks above. They are hostile to the Chicken and baby Hoglin.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.kobold: The Kobold is an underground miner creature, found in the dark places under Y=32. They spawn with a Stone Pickaxe. Their attack gives Mining Fatigue I when the difficulty is normal or above.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.lich: The Lich is a powerful undead wizard living deep underground, found in the dark areas under Y=0.$(br2)They attack by shooting magical bullets and can give Slowness I. When the enemy is close nearby, they also summon Vexes for help. Therefore, it is inadvisable to rashly approach the Lich if your equipment isn't strong enough.$(br2)The Lich is resistant to fire, magic and Powder Snow damage. They are undead, but can swim in water.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.magical_slime: The Magical Slime is a variant of the Slime. When a Slime Girl is slain, some Magical Slimes of the smallest size are generated. The smallest Magical Slime can still deal damage. They are resistant to falling and magic damage.$(br2)They have 32 different colors like the Slime Girl, and drop Slime Balls when slain.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.melty_monster: The Melty Monster is a spirit of the fire element, found in the lava in the Overworld and Nether.$(br2)They attack by shooting Fire Charges like the Blaze. When a Melty Monster steps onto a solid block, they will ignite the block.$(br2)The Melty Monster is immune to fire, and takes damage in water. They escape from the Strider and are neutral to players riding a Strider.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.monolith: The Monolith is an ancient automated defensive device, found rarely in the Small End Islands and End Barrens, and commonly in the End City.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.monolith_1: The Monolith doesn't move when they don't detect a player. They can perform 2 types of distant attacks depending on the distance of the enemy. When the enemy is far away, they perform beam attack like the Guardian, and give Weakness I, Slowness I and Mining Fatigue I. When the enemy is nearby, they spray smoke, causing Weakness II, Blindness, Slowness II, Mining Fatigue II and knockback.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.monolith_2: The Monolith is resistant to fire, explosion, magic and Cactus, but weak to the Pickaxe.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.necrotic_reaper: The Necrostalker is an undead creature living in the darkness, found below Y=0 in the overworld. They attack with their scythe-shaped arms and give Slowness I.$(br2)As an undead mob, they burn under the sun.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.nightwalker: The Nightwalker is a golem creature found in the Badland biomes above Y=64. They attack by shooting magical bullets, giving Mining Fatigue I. As a magical golem, they are resistant to magic damage, but too heavy to float in water.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.ogre: The Ogre is a strong monster living in the cave, found below Y=0 in the Overworld.$(br2)As a powerful creature, they can break blocks when attacking, causing a strong knockback and Slowness IV effect. They are highly resistant to suffocation and Cactus, and also resistant to projectiles, explosions, fire, falling, Powder Snow and falling blocks.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.redcap: The Redcap is a woodcutter creature found in the Dark Forest biomes above Y=64. They hold an axe as equipment, and sometimes also wear Iron or Chainmail Boots. The Axe attack can disable the shield.$(br2)When a Redcap is defeated, they can drop some Cureberry which can recover some health when eaten.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.savagefang: The Savagefang is a fierce and hostile fish found in the Swamp and Jungle biomes. They attack their prey in groups, and are hostile to players, animals, Villagers and even other hostile mobs. When the target is on the land, they can also jump out of the water to attack.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.scorpion: The Scorpion is a fierce arthropod found in the Desert and Badlands biomes above Y=64. Their melee attack can give Poison I.$(br2)The Scorpion is immune to Poison effect. As an arthropod, they are weak to the Bane of Arthropod enchantment.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.skeleton_girl: The Skeleton Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of Skeletons in the Overworld. Their behaviors are similar to Vanilla Skeletons while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.slime_girl: The Slime Girl is a creature living in the wet places. They can be found in the Swamp and Mangrove Swamp biomes above Y=64. Their melee attack gives Slowness II effect.$(br2)They get Regeneration III in water or rain, and are resistant to falling and magic damage.$(br2)The Slime Girl has 32 different colors.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.slime_girl_1: When a Slime Girl is defeated, they have a chance to drop the Cubic Nucleus. This is a food which can give Regeneration I effect. However, it's more useful as an ingredient for making advanced items and the Potion of Regeneration III.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.snow_canine: The Snow Canine is an animal living in the cold places. They are found in the Snowy Plains biomes above Y=64.$(br2)They attack with a strong knockback, and are resistant to falling damage. They actively hunt Sheep and Rabbits.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.spider_nest: The Spider Nest is a mob as a nest of Cave Spiders, found in the dark area below Y=0 in the Overworld.$(br2)They can summon Cave Spiders besides melee attack, and also spawn Cave Spiders after death. Their melee attack gives Poison I and Slowness I.$(br2)The Spider Nest is immune to Poison, and resistant to projectiles, Cactus and explosions. As an arthropod, they are weak to fire and the Bane of Arthropod enchantment. Their movement is not affected by the Cobweb.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.stray_girl: The Stray Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of Strays in the Overworld. Their behaviors are similar to the vanilla Stray while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.swamper: The Swamper is an octopus-like monster found in the Swamp and Mangrove Swamp biomes above Y=64.$(br2)They can perform both melee and distant attack. The melee attack can give Poison I and Slowness I. The distant attack (ink spraying) causes Blindness effect.$(br2)The Swamper can breathe underwater, and will suffocate in dry biomes outside water. They are weak to fire damage and resistant to falling.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.wither_ghost: The Wither Ghost is a more dangerous variant of the Ghost found in the Nether. Their behaviors are the same as the Ghost in the Overworld, but the attack can give Wither I effect. Also, they are immune to Wither and fire damage.$(br2)The Wither Ghost has 5 different textures.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.wither_skeleton_g: The Wither Skeleton Girl spawns occasionally in place of the Wither Skeleton in the Nether. Their behaviors are similar to the vanilla Wither Skeleton while the attributes are higher. Rarely they can spawn with a Bow instead of a Stone Sword, and the arrows can ignite the target on hit.
dict.nffgirls.desc.mob.zombie_girl: The Zombie Girl is a common mob which spawns occasionally in place of Zombies in the Overworld. Their behaviors are similar to Vanilla Zombies while the attributes are a bit higher.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.alraune: To get friendly with an Alraune, you need to right-click to give them items. To give, the mob must have Regeneration III effect for over 10 seconds, meaning you need Splash Potion of Regeneration III to satisfy the condition.$(br)After being friendly, they have 3 Bauble slots. They can shoot poisonous seeds at the enemy, causing Poison I, Weakness I and Slowness I effects. The seed doesn't affect the owner, the owner's other monster girls or tamed animals.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.alraune_1: When they see an ally with health <50%, they can shoot a healing seed, restoring 1 health and providing Regeneration I effect.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.banshee: To get friendly with a Banshee, first you need to arrange a field of wither. You're required to be in the Wither effect, and there must be over 8 Wither Roses around you on the ground. Then you can right click to give them items.$(br2)Note that the friending progress will drop quickly when there aren't enough Wither Roses. If you're hit by the mob, you'll enter a cooling time of 60 seconds during which you cannot give any items to them.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.banshee_1: After getting friendly, you can put items on their hands, and they have 3 Bauble slots. Note that the item on their off-hand cannot be stacked no matter what it is.$(br2)If they are holding a flower on the off-hand, they will provide effects depending on the flower type, same as the corresponding Suspicious Stew's effect. If the effect is positive, it will apply to the owner and allies within 8 blocks around; the negative effects will be applied on the enemy when hit.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.creeper_gir: To get friendly with a Creeper Girl, first you must right-click to give them items.

When the progress is full, they will stop moving, swell for 4 seconds with massive green star and smoke particles. After the 4 seconds, they will make a HUGE EXPLOSION (power 12). During this process, you must not get over 8 blocks away from the Creeper Girl, or the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from giving items. You must survive the explosion no matter what, and they will finally get friendly with you.

After getting friendly, you can equip armor and hand items to them. They also have an ammo slot which accepts Gunpowder or TNT. If they have ammo, they can approach the enemy and perform explosions. Gunpowder cannot break blocks but TNT can. Also, you can use a Particle of Lightning by Shift + Right-click to charge them, and their next explosion will have double power. Shift + Right-click your charged Creeper Girl to uncharge them and recover a Particle of Lightning.
Their explosions will not hurt themselves, but can hurt any players and mobs. The explosions will not kill the owner's other monster girls or tamed animals, but can kill their owner.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.crimson_sla: To get friendly with a Crimson Slaughterer, first you must suppress their hostility with Warped blocks before giving items. They must be standing on a Warped block. If so, they will get Slowness I effect, but the attack knockback will become very strong. Also, there must be >16 Shroomlight blocks around. If there aren't enough, the friending progress will drop quickly.$(br2)After being friendly, they have 4 Bauble slots.

If you're close to your Crimson Slaughterer, they will give you 1 hunger value each 10 seconds. Specifically, if you're holding a Crimson Bow, they don't give but remove 1 hunger value until the hunger reaches 7, allowing you to make more damage with the bow.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.cursed_doll: To get friendly with a Cursed Doll, you must heal their wounds with Wools and Strings. Give a Wool followed by a String to finish a “sewing” action. You need 8 such actions in total with a Wool of different color every time.$(br2)During this process, the Cursed Doll will keep hostile to you. If you're attacked, they will randomly drop a Wool you've given, and the corresponding “sewing” action will be cancelled.
After getting friendly, you can put items on their hands, and they have 6 Bauble slots. Although not undead, they can equip the Soul Amulet.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.dodomeki: To get friendly with a Dodomeki, you need to give them items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which can make them neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.$(br2)Note that once you provoke them during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.dodomeki_1: After getting friendly, they have 4 Bauble slots. Although not undead, they can equip the Soul Amulet.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.drowned_gir: To get friendly with a Drowned Girl, you need to give them items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.$(br2)Note that once you provoke them during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.
After getting friendly, you can equip them with armor and hand items. They have 2 Bauble slots. They can also use the Trident.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.dullahan: To get friendly with a Dullahan, you need to give them items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which can make them neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.$(br2)Note that once you provoke them during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.dullahan_1: After getting friendly, you can modify their hand items. They have 2 Bauble slots. Although not undead, they can equip the Soul Amulet.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.ender_execu: To get friendly with an Ender Executor, you must first provoke them by looking at their eye. Then you have to give items while resisting their attack. Note that hiding yourself behind blocks is not an option - the friending process will drop if they cannot reach you for over 10 seconds. Shield-block the attack instead. Also, getting over 8 blocks away from them will interrupt the process, and you have to restart from the beginning. This process is incredibly dangerous, and be sure to prepare well before doing this.

After being friendly, you can equip items on their hands, and they have 2 Bauble slots. They also have a block slot, and the block in the slot will be held in their hand, but not giving any bonus in attributes now. Note that the block and off-hand slots are not compatible.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.ghastly_see: To get friendly with a Ghastly Seeker, you must first bring them to the Overworld. When they are in the Overworld and can see the sky, you can right-click to give them items.$(br2)After getting friendly, the Ghastly Seeker has 4 Bauble slots. Although not undead, they can equip the Soul Amulet.

They require ammo to shoot fireballs, either the Fire Charge or the Blasting Bottle. The Fire Charge can make normal explosion and not break blocks. The Blasting Bottle can make larger explosion and break blocks. The fireball explosion will be also enhanced while their XP level increases.

If you have difficulties bringing them into the Overworld, you can try using the Reinforced Fishing Rod. This tool is similar to the vanilla Fishing Rod, but much more capable in pulling entities. When it hooks an entity, by right-clicking you can pull it multiple times without retrieving the hook, and the pulling force is also much stronger than the vanilla Fishing Rod. This action doesn't consume extra durability. Shift + Right-click to retrieve the hook. The Reinforced Fishing Rod can be repaired on the Anvil with the Reinforcing Chain. Indeed, you can fish with it as well.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.glaryad: To get friendly with a Glaryad, you need to right-click to give them items. To give, the mob must have Regeneration III effect for over 10 seconds, meaning you need Splash Potion of Regeneration III to satisfy the condition. Also, you must hold a Mysterious Petal on the off-hand. Note that you must not have provoked the mob before.$(br2)After being friendly, the Glaryad has 3 Bauble slots.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.harpy: To get friendly with a Harpy, you must drop the item on the ground. They will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item. As the progress increases, they will get Strength effect. Each 20% progress will provide 1 level of the effect.$(br2)After getting friendly, the Harpy has 4 Bauble slots.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.hornet: To get friendly with a Hornet, you must set up a field of honey before giving items. There must be 8 honey blocks around, otherwise the friendly progress will drop quickly. If you're attacked by the mob, you'll enter a cool time of 60 seconds during which you cannot give items.$(br2)After getting friendly, you can equip them with hand items, and they have 2 Bauble slots.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.husk_girl: To get friendly with a Husk Girl, you need to give them items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.$(br2)Note that once you provoke them during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.husk_girl_1: After getting friendly, you can equip them with armor and hand items. They have 2 Bauble slots.Like the vanilla Husk, they will convert to the Zombie Girl after sinking into water for a few seconds. This conversion can be reverted with a Sponge.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.imp: To get friendly with an Imp, you must drop the item on the ground. They will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item.$(br2)When the progress reaches 70%, they will become neutral.$(br2)After being friendly, you can put an item on their main hand, and they have 2 Bauble slots.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.imp_1: If they have a Netherite Fork on the main hand and a Tiny Netherite Scrap on the off-hand (metal nugget icon), they can locate the Ancient Debris nearby. If they locate an Ancient Debris, they will consume a Netherite Scrap, try to walk toward the block and generate a lot of green star particles. They locate the Debris only in the Follow mode.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.imp_2: The Netherite Fork can be obtained by upgrading the Golden Fork with a Netherite Ingot. If you have problems getting a Golden Fork, you can also make it on the Crafting Table, but it's really expensive.$(br2)(*Note: take care using Ancient Debris locating feature. Now block locating has issues which can cause a waste of metal nuggets.)
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.jack_frost: To get friendly with a Jack o' Frost, you must drop the item on the ground. They will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item.$(br2)After getting friendly, they have 4 Bauble slots. To make them immune to the hot biomes, they must equip a Resistance Amulet.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.jack_frost_: The friendly Jack o' Frost can also only attack by shooting snowballs. Upon the XP level increasing, the snowball's damage will be enhanced. When their XP level reaches a certain value, they will be able to shoot more snowballs each attack.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.jiangshi: To get friendly with a Jiangshi, you must “tame” them in the style of a Taoist.$(br2)First you need to prepare some Taoist Talismans. Using a talisman on a Jiangshi will freeze their actions for 10s. When frozen, they will obtain 20 extra armor value. Then you need to attack them with a Peach-Wood Sword when they are frozen. After attacking, they will be immediately unfrozen and the talisman has a chance to be recovered. You need overall 6 hits to finish the process.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.jiangshi_1: Each time you hit the Jiangshi, they will become stronger and release more smoke particles. After 3 hits, they will be hit by a thunderbolt, and their knockback will become really strong. After 6 hits, another thunderbolt will strike, and they are finally tamed.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.jiangshi_2: Besides taming the Jiangshi, the Peach-Wood Sword is also a powerful weapon against the undead mobs. When hit an undead mob, it will deal damage with an amount 50% of the mob's maximum health, bypassing vanilla damage reducing mechanics. The extra damage will consume extra durability, and note that its durability is only equal to the Wooden Sword.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.jiangshi_3: Specifically, the hostile Jiangshi will not take the extra damage but get Weakness II effect. The friendly Jiangshi will take this damage.$(br2)After getting friendly, the Jiangshi has 4 Bauble slots. When they are thunder-struck, they will not take damage but get powerful effects, including Strength III, Damage Absorption III and Fire Resistance for 1 minute, and get 20 experience.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.kobold: To get friendly with a Kobold, you must drop the item on the ground. They will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item.$(br2)When the progress reaches 70%, they will become neutral.$(br2)After getting friendly, you can set their hand items, and they have 2 Bauble slots.$(br2)Their main hand accepts only pickaxes. If the pickaxe has a Fortune enchantment, killing mobs will drop more items as if it had a Looting enchantment.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.kobold_1: If they are holding a mineral nugget on the off-hand, they will help locate ores nearby. When finding an ore, they will consume a nugget, try walking to the ore and generate a lot of green star particles. Now they support Coal, Copper, Iron, Gold, Lapis Lazuli, Emerald and Redstone. For Coal, Lapis and Redstone, they need the mineral itself instead of the nugget. They locate ores only when in the Follow mode.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.kobold_2: (*Note: take care using ore locating feature. Now block locating has issues which can cause a waste of metal nuggets.)
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.melty_monst: To get friendly with a Melty Monster, you need to be “Into Fire” before giving items. You must be either in the Lava or on fire, and NOT having a Fire Resistance effect. Each item given, you'll get Combustion effect for 30s.

After getting friendly, they have 4 Bauble slots and a Lava Bucket slot. The Lava Bucket slot only receives Lava Bucket, and changes their behavior. If the Lava Bucket is present, their movement speed will increase on the ground, and they will not try to return to the Lava.

The Melty Monster has a “Heat” property. They will consume “Heat” outside the Lava, and equipping a Lava Bucket can slow the consuming. The Heat will be restored when they are in Lava. If the Heat runs out, they will be unable to fire, their movement will slow down, and they will try to return to Lava no matter if they are equipping a Lava Bucket. Their maximum Heat will increase while the XP level boosts.

They attack by shooting fireballs like the Blaze. Each fireball consumes 5 Heat. When they reach some specific XP levels, they will be able to shoot more fireballs in a single attack, and also consume more Heat.$(br2)Right click with a Water Bucket to prevent them from igniting their standing block. Use a Flint and Steel to enable igniting.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.necrotic_re: To get friendly with a Necrostalker, you need to satisfy them with Necromancy. You need to be both wearing a Necromancer's Hat and holding a Necromancer's Wand.

Right-click with a Necromancer's Wand to shoot a magic ball. During the friending process, you must first make them stand onto the Soul Carpet somehow, and attack them with the magic ball. You need 6 hits overall. After each hit, they will get much stronger, and generate more smoke particles. This means it will be deadly if you're attacked by the Necrostalker after your several magic ball hits.

Note that hiding yourself behind blocks or escaping non-stop are not options. Their hit count will drop once they cannot reach you for 10s. Shield-block the attack instead. If you're too far from the mob (>32 blocks away), the process will be interrupted, and you'll have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you still need to either wear a Necromancer's Hat or hold a Necromancer's Wand to make them follow your commands. Otherwise, they won't follow you or attack your target, unless the favorability is above 90. To switch their AI or open their GUI, you also need a Necromancer's Wand instead of a Commanding Wand.

The Necrostalker's hand items can be customized, and only receive hoes as weapon. You can also put other items onto the off-hand but without any effects. Their attack damage will be boosted depending on the quality of the hoes. If the main hand hoe has a Fortune enchantment, killing mobs will drop more items as if it had a Looting enchantment. Also, they have 4 Bauble slots.

The Necromancer's Hat's defense is the same as the Leather Hat, but also gives you Strength II and Haste II effects, as well as the Curse of Necromancy. The curse effect will slowly damage you, and the damage bypasses vanilla damage reducing mechanics. Standing on the Soul Carpet will prevent you from getting cursed. If your Necrostalkers are nearby when you're wearing the hat, they will give you the Regeneration effect, and the effect level depends on the amount of Necrostalkers (III at most).

The magic ball from the Necromancer's Wand can also damage mobs. When a magic ball hits a block or mob, it will burst and give Wither effect to mobs nearby. The Wither effect will be even stronger if the mob is directly hit by the magic ball. Your own Necrostalker will not take Wither but get healed and Strength effect. The Necromancer's Wand can be repaired on the Anvil with Death Crystal Powder.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.nightwalker: To get friendly with a Nightwalker, you must first set up a field to boost their power before giving items. They must be standing on a Luminous Terracotta or Enhanced Luminous Terracotta. After giving, they will decay blocks they are standing on.

The Luminous Terracotta and Enhanced Luminous Terracotta are Terracotta variants which emit 7 and 15 light level respectively. The Luminous Terracotta can be obtained when a Nightwalker's magic ball hits a Glazed Terracotta block, or by crafting. The Enhanced Luminous Terracotta can be obtained only when a Nightwalker's magic ball hits a Luminous Terracotta block.$(br2)After getting friendly, the Nightwalker has 4 Bauble slots, and an ammo slot.

The ammo slot accepts Clay Ball and Ancient Stone. A Clay Ball can boost their magic balls' damage. An Ancient Stone can further boost the damage, and expand the range of converting blocks. They can fire without ammo.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.redcap: To get friendly with a Redcap, you must drop the item on the ground. They will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item.$(br2)After getting friendly, you can equip them with armor (except the helmet) and hand items. They have 1 Bauble slot.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.redcap_1: Their main hand slot only receives axes. If you're also holding an axe on the main hand, they will provide Haste effect of level depending on their holding axe: Below Diamond - Haste I; Diamond or equal: Haste II; Above Diamond (including Netherite) - Haste III.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.skeleton_gi: To get friendly with a Skeleton Girl, you need to give them items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.$(br2)Note that once you provoke them during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip them with armor and hand items. They have 2 Bauble slots.$(br2)They require arrows to shoot, and can auto switch between the main and secondary weapons, either bows or melee weapons, depending on the distance to their enemy.Like the vanilla Skeleton, they will convert to the Stray Girl after standing in the Powder Snow for a few seconds. This conversion can be reverted by using a Flint and Steel.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.slime_girl: To get friendly with a Slime Girl, you need to provide the Magical Gel by giving Magical Gel Balls or from Magical Gel Bottles. The gel in the Magical Gel Bottle has a color. The closer its color is to the Slime Girl's color, the more efficient it will be. The Magical Gel Ball is much less efficient (only 2-4% each), so it's recommended to use the bottle.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.slime_girl_: The Magical Gel Ball is a throwable item. If a thrown Magical Gel Ball hits a large vanilla Slime, it has a chance (25%) to generate a small Magical Slime of random color. If it hits a Slime Girl, it has a chance to generate a small Magical Slime of the complementary color of the Slime Girl. Hitting a non-slime mob will give a knockback and Slowness II for 30s.

The Magical Gel Bottle is an item for getting friendly with the Slime Girl, and modifying the color of friendly Slime Girls. Right-click a Magical Gel Bottle to a small Magical Slime to collect it as gel of the same color. If there's already content in the bottle, the color will be blended into the existing gel.

Each bottle's capacity is 6. If you're trying to collect a Magical Slime with a full bottle, the extra unit of gel will drop as a Magical Gel Ball after blending the color. Craft with an empty Magical Gel Bottle to divide the content into 2 bottles.$(br2)Also, crafting a Magical Gel Bottle with an HMaG mob ingredient can also modify its color.

When getting friendly with a Slime Girl with a Magical Gel Bottle, the progress provided by a single unit of gel depends on how close the gel's color is to the Slime Girl's color. Note that the progress may drop if you're using a color too far from their color. If the progress increases, they will generate green star particles; otherwise they generate angry particles.

To estimate the Slime Girl's color, you can hit them with a Magical Gel Ball to generate a Magical Slime of the complementary color, collect it with an empty bottle and see the color.$(br2)After getting friendly, the Slime Girl has 4 Bauble slots. Their color can be modified with the Magical Gel Bottle, and after modification they have a chance to drop a Magical Gel Ball. Note that the magical gel's color will be blended with the Slime Girl's original color.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.snow_canine: To get friendly with a Snow Canine, you must drop the item on the ground. They will pick the item up, watch it for a few seconds like the Piglin, and consume the item. As the progress increases, they will get Strength effect. Each 20% progress will provide 1 level of the effect.$(br2)After getting friendly, the Snow Canine has 4 Bauble slots.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.stray_girl: To get friendly with a Stray Girl, you need to give them items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.$(br2)Note that once you provoke them during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.stray_girl_: After getting friendly, you can equip them with armor and hand items. They have 2 Bauble slots.$(br2)They require arrows to shoot, and can auto switch between the main and secondary weapons, either bows or melee weapons, depending on the distance to their enemy.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.wither_skel: To get friendly with a Wither Skeleton Girl, you need to give them items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.$(br2)Note that once you provoke them during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip them with armor and hand items. They have 2 Bauble slots.$(br2)They require arrows to shoot, and can auto switch between the main and secondary weapons, either bows or melee weapons, depending on the distance to their enemy.
dict.nffgirls.desc.friending.zombie_girl: To get friendly with a Zombie Girl, you need to give them items by right-clicking. Before giving, you must have an Undead Affinity effect which makes undead mobs neutral. You can get this effect by eating Soul Cake or Soul Cake Slice, stepping on the Soul Carpet or wearing a Necromancer's Hat.$(br2)Note that once you provoke them during the friending process, no matter how, the process will be interrupted, and you have to restart from the beginning.

After getting friendly, you can equip them with armor and hand items. They have 2 Bauble slots.Like the vanilla Zombie, they will convert to the Drowned Girl after sinking into water for a few seconds. This conversion can be reverted with a Sponge.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ancient_stone: A unique ingredient for Ancient Stone Blocks, Ancient suit, Ancient Shield and Nemesis Blade.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.burning_core: A unique ingredient for advanced items like Fortress Shield and Potion of Combustion. Entities with Combustion effect will be on fire during the whole affected time. It can also perform as a fuel.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.crimson_cuticula: A rare unique ingredient for Crimson Bow, Nemesis Blade and some other items. It can also be used to make the Potion of Voracity.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.cubic_nucleus: A food which can give Regeneration I effect. More useful as an ingredient for making advanced items and the Potion of Regeneration III.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.cureberry: A food item that can recover some health when eaten.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.dyssomnia_skin: A rare unique ingredient for insomnia items.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ender_plasm: A unique ingredient that can be used to make advanced items like Endless Pearl and the Potion of Ender Rage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.evil_crystal_fra: A basic ingredient for most items in this mod.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.experience_berry: A food that can give you some XP when eaten.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.golden_fork: A weapon slightly weaker than the Golden Sword. Can be upgraded to a Netherite Fork on the Smithing Table.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.iron_spear: A weapon slightly weaker than the Iron Sword.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.kobold_leather: A unique ingredient for making some items in this mod, and brewing the Potion of Kobold's Wisdom.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.lich_cloth: An important ingredient for making many advanced items like the Cloth of Purification, and Potions of Healing and Harming III.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.mysterious_petal: A unique ingredient useful to make advanced items like Enchanted Golden Apples.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.necrofiber: A unique ingredient that can be used to make the Necrotic Chainmail suit, which provides extra attacking speed.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ogre_horn: The ingredient of the Potion of Ogre's Strength, giving Strength II and Haste I as well as Slowness II effects.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.randomberry: This food can give you a random effect for a short time, either positive or negative.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.sharp_fang: A unique ingredient for making some items like Reinforcing Chain, and also as the arrow head.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.soul_powder: A useful ingredient for many items in this mod.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.swamper_tentacle: A food that can be cooked and made into a stew.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.glowstone_dust: An occasional drop from the Ghost.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.magma_cream: A drop from the Melty Monster.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.wither_rose: An occasional drop from the Wither Ghost.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.necromancer_hat: A cursed hat of the necromancer. Grants great power when worn, but continuously drains health. Standing on a Soul Carpet temporarily negates the curse.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.necromancer_wand: A weapon of the necromancer. Right-click to consume your own health and fire a magic bullet that inflicts a powerful Wither effect; wearing the Necromancer's Hat enhances this. Using it on your own Necrostalker does not cause Wither and instead heals and buffs it. Can be repaired on an Anvil with Death Crystal Powder.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.sunhat: When equipped on undead mobs, it blocks sunlight damage without wearing down from sun exposure itself.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.netherite_fork: Obtained by upgrading a Golden Fork on the Smithing Table. Imps need this tool to find Ancient Debris.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.commanding_wand: A key tool of NFF: Girls for switching mob-girl AI modes, opening the GUI panel, and locating mob-girls. See hover tooltips for usage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.combat_commandin: A key tool of NFF: Girls for commanding mob-girls in combat. See hover tooltips for usage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.peach_wood_sword: A Taoist implement for suppressing the undead. Can attack an immobilized Jiangshi (held by a Taoist Talisman) to tame it. Inflicts powerful debuffs when attacking other undead mobs.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.reinforced_fishi: A very durable fishing rod for pulling entities. Once hooked, right-click multiple times to reel in without retracting the hook; stronger pulling force than the vanilla rod, consuming only 1 durability per pull. Shift+Right click to retract the hook. Can also be used for fishing.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.death_crystal: An ingredient used to craft food and equipment. Can be combined with a Diamond on the crafting table to grind it into powder.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.death_crystal_po: An ingredient used to craft food and equipment. 9 pieces can be combined to form a Crystal of Death.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.soul_flour: An ingredient used to craft food.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.soul_cloth: An ingredient used to craft various equipment.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ender_fruit_jam: An ingredient used to craft food.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.evil_gem: A universal currency for trading items with mob-girls.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.soul_cake_slice: The favorite food of undead monster girls. Grants Undead Affinity for 8 minutes, Regeneration II for 8 minutes, and 0.4 seconds of Saturation when eaten.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.enderberry: A berry that teleports you when eaten. Can be planted on Evil Crystal Blocks, Ancient Stone Blocks, or Ender Plasm Blocks, and requires a friendly Ender Executor's assistance to grow. Can also be crafted.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ender_pie: The favorite food of Ender monster girls. Grants Ender Protection for 9 minutes, Regeneration II for 9 minutes, and Resistance IV for 3 minutes when eaten.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.transferring_tag: Used to transfer ownership of an NFF mob. Right-click your mob to sign the tag; then give it to another player, who right-clicks the same mob to complete the transfer. Right-clicking your own signed tag locks or unlocks it; a locked tag cannot be used by others, making it safe for storage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.empty_magical_ge: An empty Magical Gel Bottle. See the "Magical Gel Bottle" entry for usage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.magical_gel_ball: A material related to Slime Girls. Can also be thrown; hitting non-slime entities slows them down.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.taoist_talisman: A Taoist implement used to tame Jiangshi. Right-click an untamed Jiangshi to immobilize it.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.trade_introducti: Obtainable by spending trade points from your NFF mob's trade page. Giving it to another of your NFF mobs refreshes their trade offers.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.attacking_strate: Used to configure the attacking strategy of your NFF mob. See hover tooltips for usage.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.empty_mob_storag: Right-click your NFF mob to store it. Single use.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.soul_cake: The favorite food of undead monster girls. Can be placed and eaten like a vanilla Cake. Has 7 slices; each provides Undead Affinity for 5 minutes, Regeneration I for 5 minutes, and 0.25 seconds of Saturation. To give it to a mob-girl, cut it into Soul Cake Slices first using a crafting table.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.soul_carpet: A decorative block. Entities standing on it receive a temporary Undead Affinity effect.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.luminous_terraco: A light-emitting block with light level 7. Generated when a Nightwalker's magic bullet hits a Glazed Terracotta block.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.enhanced_luminou: A light-emitting block with light level 15. Generated when a Nightwalker's magic bullet hits a Luminous Terracotta block.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.nemesis_blade: A netherite-tier epic sword. Its power depends on the player's experience level (stronger at lower XP). When in inventory below level 0, reduces movement speed by 50%. On hit, can inflict random debuffs (Weakness, Slowness, or Mining Fatigue). Right-clicking launches a magic projectile.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.insomnia_sword: A diamond-tier sword whose power scales with the player's sleep deprivation (max level 5, requiring 7+ days without sleeping). Right-clicking while holding grants Slow Falling for 10 seconds. The insomnia level will be reset to 0 after sleeping.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.crimson_bow: A special bow with 575 durability. Its arrow damage scales with the wielder's hunger - dealing more damage at lower hunger levels. Has a very high arrow velocity.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ancient_shield: A shield with 671 durability that provides additional knockback resistance. Has a chance to apply Slowness, Weakness, or Mining Fatigue I to attackers when blocking.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.fortress_shield: A shield with 671 durability. Has a chance to set attackers on fire for 8 seconds when blocking. Reduces fire damage taken by 75% while blocking.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ancient_armor: An armor set providing 20 total defense (helmet 3, chestplate 8, leggings 6, boots 3), 2.5 toughness, and slight knockback resistance. Wearing multiple pieces increases resistance to Slowness, Weakness, and Mining Fatigue effects.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.necrotic_chainma: An armor set providing 15 total defense (helmet 2, chestplate 6, leggings 5, boots 2) and 2.0 toughness. Each piece worn increases attack speed by 10%.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.lemon: A simple fruit. Restores 1 hunger point.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.soul_apple: A ghostly fruit. Restores 1.5 hunger points, heals a small amount, and grants Invisibility I for 3 seconds.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.honeyed_apple: A sweet food that removes Poison effects when eaten. Restores 3 hunger points.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.honeyed_lemon: A honey-glazed lemon that removes Poison effects when eaten. Dropped by Giant Mummy. Restores 3 hunger points.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.lemon_pie: A pie crafted from a lemon, sugar, and an egg. Restores 3.5 hunger points.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.golden_tropical_: A rare golden tropical fish crafted by surrounding a Tropical Fish with gold ingots. Restores 2.5 hunger points. Grants Absorption II for 60 seconds, Fire Resistance for 15 seconds, and Water Breathing for 15 seconds.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.cooked_savagefan: Cooked Savagefang Meat. Restores 3 hunger points.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.cooked_swamper_t: Cooked Swamper Tentacle. Restores 3 hunger points.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.ravager_meat: Raw meat dropped by Ravagers (3-7 pieces). Restores 1 hunger point but has a 60% chance to inflict Hunger for 30 seconds. Cook to make it safe.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.cooked_ravager_m: Cooked Ravager Meat. Restores 4 hunger points and has a 10% chance to grant Damage Resistance I for 10 seconds.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.bat_stew: A stew made from bat wings and vegetables. Restores 3 hunger points and has a 30% chance to grant Darkness Resistance for 10 seconds.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.swampy_stew: A hearty swamp stew made from Cooked Savagefang Meat and Cooked Swamper Tentacle. Restores 5.5 hunger points, removes Slowness, and has a 30% chance to grant Water Breathing for 10 seconds.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.spectral_soup: A magical soup made from mushrooms and glowstone dust. Restores 3 hunger points and grants Glowing for 30 seconds.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.lightning_soup: A powerful rare soup. Restores 4.5 hunger points. Grants Glowing, Night Vision, Strength I, Haste I, Speed II, and Jump Boost II, all for 60 seconds. Also strikes lightning at the consumer's position.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.insomnia_fruit: An infinitely edible rare fruit whose effects scale with sleep deprivation (each in-game day without sleeping increases its level, max level 5 after 7+ days). At level 0 (well-rested), eating inflicts severe debuffs and make the fruit disappear!!!(Hunger II, Blindness, Weakness II, Combustion for 3 minutes). At higher levels, grants positive effects like Regeneration, Night Vision, and Absorption. The insomnia level will be reset to 0 after sleeping.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.fire_bottle: A throwable bottle that creates a small explosion (radius 1.0) on impact. Can be used as fuel.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.blasting_bottle: A throwable bottle that creates a medium explosion (radius 2.5) on impact. Can also be used as fuel.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.lightning_bottle: A throwable bottle that summons a lightning bolt at the point of impact. Can be found in End City treasure chests.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.evil_flame: Right-click on a living entity to set it on fire for 3 seconds. Consumed on use. Can be used as fuel.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.evil_thorn: Right-click on a living entity to deal 1 point of thorns damage to it. Consumed on use.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.purification_clo: Using this cloth (hold use) removes all non-essential negative status effects from the player. Consumed on use.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.endless_pearl: A reusable Ender Pearl that is not consumed when thrown. Has a 1-second cooldown. Crouching when throwing doubles the projectile speed.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.evil_arrow: An arrow crafted by surrounding an Evil Crystal Fragment with 8 regular arrows (yields 8). Deals slightly more damage than regular arrows.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.evil_crystal: Crafted from 9 Evil Crystal Fragments. A key ingredient for many advanced HMaG recipes and smithing upgrades.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.bat_wing: An ingredient dropped by bats. Used to craft Bat Stew.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.lightning_partic: A rare ingredient dropped by powered (charged) creepers. Also sold by wandering traders.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.diamond_fragment: A fragment dropped by Dyssomnia, Lich, Dogu, Ogre, and Melty Monster. Also found in certain dungeon chests.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.emerald_fragment: A fragment dropped by Dyssomnia, Lich, Jack Frost, Alraune, and Giant Mummy.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.tiny_netherite_s: A fire-resistant upgrade material crafted from various nether-related ingredients including Evil Crystal, Wither-related materials, and Burning Core or Crimson Cuticula. Also found in Bastion Remnant chests.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.nether_star_frag: Crafted by placing a Nether Star in the crafting table, yielding 9 fragments. Explosion-resistant.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.thorn_sand: A variant of Soul Sand. Slows entities walking on it and deals 1 damage (thorn type) per tick to entities inside.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.poison_sand: A variant of Soul Sand. Slows entities walking on it and applies Poison I for 5 seconds to entities inside.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.wither_sand: A variant of Soul Sand. Slows entities walking on it and applies Wither I for 2 seconds to entities inside. Can support Wither Roses.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.healing_sand: A variant of Soul Sand. Slows entities walking on it and applies Regeneration I for 5 seconds to entities inside.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.reinforced_block: A block that cannot be destroyed by entity griefing (e.g., Wither, TNT entities, Ender Dragon). Comes in multiple variants.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.reinforced_glass: A transparent glass block that cannot be destroyed by entity griefing.
dict.nffgirls.desc.item.tinted_reinforce: A tinted glass block that cannot be destroyed by entity griefing. Blocks light like Tinted Glass.
dict.nffgirls.desc.interaction.friending: Generally, you need satisfy them to be friendly with a monster girl by giving them items.$(br2)Most mobs requires you to right-click with the items in hand to give. Sometimes the action of giving also requires additional conditions, such as effects or equipment. After giving, the "Friending Progress" increases depending on the item types.

Some types of mobs have totally different methods to get friendly with, described under the entries of specific mobs.$(br2)Generally, there are cheap and expensive items to give. Cheap items can slightly boost the progress, while the expensive ones can significantly boost the progress, and sometimes even, if lucky enough, succeed immediately.

Note that the giving action has a cool-down time. After giving successfully, the mob will generate glint (green stars) particles. If failed due to the cool-down, it will generate black smoke particles. Each time the progress increases by 20%, the mob will generate a heart particle.$(br2)If other conditions are satisfied, but you've already been hostile to the mob, it will generate anger particles.

Some hostile behaviors can interrupt the progress. Once interrupted, the progress will drop back to 0, and you have to start from the beginning. At this time the mob will also generate anger particles.$(br2)Some mobs are more alert, and you need to put the present on the ground. They will pick them up like Piglins, hold the item for a few seconds, consume it and boost the progress.
Required item types are shown in the corresponding JEI tab. Note that mobs using unconventional friending processes are not shown in JEI, and can be found in this guidebook.
dict.nffgirls.desc.interaction.favorabil: The favorability indicates the affinity between the player and monster girls. The value is between 0-100 and initially 50.$(br2)You can slightly increase the favorability by doing things below:$(br2)a) Sleeping beside your monster girls. It will boost favorability by 2 each time.

b) Fight and defeat enemies with your monster girls.$(br2)c) Heal your monster girls with items.$(br2)Take care that activities below will GREATLY drop the favorability:$(br2)a) Killing the monster girl by yourself will drop the favorability directly to 0!
b) Attacking your monster girl. The favorability drop depends on the damage. A slight hit will not impact the favorability.$(br2)c) Watching your monster girl dying in front you. It loses by 20.

The monster girls' attack damage and trade price will be impacted by favorability. Besides, if the favorability is lower than 5, the monster girl will refuse to follow you or attack your target.$(br2)For Love and Peace, be friendly to your monster girls!
dict.nffgirls.desc.interaction.interacti: To interact with a monster girl, you need a Commanding Wand. Right click the mob with a Commanding Wand to switch itsbehaviors among Waiting, Following and Wandering. They will attack mobs which are attacking it or the owner, or the owner is attacking.

Some items can be used to heal the monster girl. Hold the item on the main hand and right-click the mob to heal. Healing items are shown in the corresponding JEI tab.$(br2)Shift + Right click with a Commanding Wand to open the GUI of the monster girl. The GUI shows basic data and attributes of the mob.

Also, you can customize the mob's inventory. Some mobs can equip weapons and/or armors to boost the attributes, and most enchantments can also take effects.$(br2)Most mobs can equip "Baubles" in the slots with the gem icon. These slots accept only specific Bauble items and provide effects depending on item types. Most Bauble effects are repeatable.

Right click with bare hand or the Evil Gem to trade with the mobs. The Evil Gem is the currency in the trade with monster girls. Trade entries are shown in the corresponding JEI tab.$(br2)Each mob has 10 trade entries. Different mobs have different trade entries, many in which provide rare items. Some trade entries are unlocked only when the mob reaches a specific XP level.

When a trade entry is out-of-stock, it will take some time to restock. Entries of higher level will take more time to restock.$(br2)You can get "Trade Points" when trading with a monster girl, and consume 128 Trade Points for a "Trade Introduction Letter". The letter can be given to another monster girl to refresh its trade entries. Also, you'll get discount depending on your favorability with the mob.
dict.nffgirls.desc.effect.undead_affinit: Undead mobs will be neutral to players or mobs with this effect.
dict.nffgirls.desc.effect.ender_protecti: Making player teleport on taking damage. If player drops into the Void with this effect, this effect will pull the player to the closest ground, and be immediately removed. If there is no ground around, it will pull the player to Y=60 and give Slow Falling for 10s.
dict.nffgirls.desc.effect.necromancer_wi: Debuff caused by Necromancer's Hat. This effect gradually causes damage which cannot be reduced by enchantments.
